fields.Name: T70 - Events Registrations Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies an Event's related Event Registrations can be reached from the full record form and that registration rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity (), open an event's full record. Scroll DOWN the record form to find the related-data sections — 'Event Registrations' and 'Event Sessions' typically appear as expandable panels or tabs further down the form. Open/expand the 'Event Registrations' (or 'Event Sessions') section and verify related rows are displayed (or a valid empty-state). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An Event full record form is open showing event detail fields
The related Event Registrations section/tab is visible with registration rows (or a valid empty-state for an event with no registrations)
The registrations grid shows registrant or status columns
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
